_note: Pluggable LLM 'brain' for reasoning/vision calls (scene intelligence, image matcher, segmenter). Default provider is openai (current behaviour). Switch with env LLM_PROVIDER=openai|bedrock|gemini, or change 'provider' here. Per-tier models overridable via env LLM_REASONING_MODEL / LLM_VISION_MODEL / LLM_FAST_MODEL. Tiers: reasoning (creative direction), vision (high-quality vision), fast (cheap vision-capable model for bulk describes + image QC). Image generation and audio are separate axes and not controlled here.
reasoning_note: Sonnet 4.6 is the director brain — Opus 4.8 is NOT available to this account on Bedrock ('not available for this account', needs AWS Sales). Sonnet 4.6 is a strong brain; the Opus delta was ~$0.20/reel, not worth blocking on Sales. To use Opus 4.8 later: get Bedrock entitlement via AWS Sales, OR add a direct Anthropic-API provider to agents/llm.py. Vision on Sonnet 4.6, QC on Haiku 4.5.

bedrock._note: Cross-region (us.*) inference profiles. Claude 4.x requires an inference profile for on-demand; the bare foundation-model id is rejected (ValidationException). IDs must be the FULL versioned profile (us.anthropic.<model>-<date>-v1:0) — the un-versioned alias us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5 is NOT a valid identifier and 400s. VERIFY a candidate id against the account/region by probing Converse before trusting it. Per-tier override: LLM_REASONING_MODEL / LLM_VISION_MODEL / LLM_FAST_MODEL. IMPORTANT — model ACCESS must be enabled per model in Bedrock > Model access for the region: as of 2026-06-25 Claude Sonnet 4.6 access is NOT enabled in us-east-1 (Converse returns AccessDeniedException / aws-marketplace:Subscribe), so SceneIntelligence silently runs its fallback. Verified-WORKING ids in this account/us-east-1: us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0 and us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0. Stopgap until 4.6 access is enabled: set LLM_REASONING_MODEL / LLM_VISION_MODEL to the 4.5 profile via env. The profile routes across us-east-1/us-east-2/us-west-2, so the IAM policy must allow foundation-model ARNs in all three + the inference-profile ARN. Bedrock uses IAM (instance role) — no API key.
